title: Sealing The Deal
summary:
Sealing The Deal
The significant increase in newbuilding tanker prices is well known. From $67.3 million in October of 2003, prices climbed rapidly over the next 18 months and have remained relatively steady at a price in the range of $128 million. With a strong orderbook for all vessel sectors, the market for newbuilding vessels does not appear to be losing momentum.

children.summary: VLCC Newbuilding VLCC Second Hand Most industry people are familiar with the International Maritime Organization's (IMO) regulations regarding the phase-out of non- double hulled tankers. This phase-out regulation has led to increased ordering at shipyards, but there are several other initiatives that may further increase the price of tankers or keep them at present levels.

children.title: A Primer for Coatings
children.summary: Protective coatings have traditionally been applied to cargo tanks in vessels that are designed to carry clean products. The newbuilding market is seeing increased interest on coating larger vessels.
